origin: a landing mid-session was pinned only as one leg of an hour-long case that fused a landing, a deferral, a second decision, a settle, a drain and two entries into the close — split out: this walk holds only that a concern a peer lands after a decision is offered at the next break and stays queued when the user says later
conduct: The user returned to settle result caching and the shape of its key, and settles result caching first, decisively: a per-session cache keyed on the normalised query, invalidated at the nightly aggregate refresh. When the session offers the concern that lands mid-flight, they say later — they want the key shape settled first. They add nothing beyond that, never signal conclusion, and answer what a rendered menu asks.

stubs.discussion-review-clean: when the engine records a dispatch of kind review — write the content to the path the dispatch response returned
stubs.discussion-peer-landing: once, immediately after the commit that records the result-caching decision — before the session takes its next turn, and before any other subtopic is touched — acting as the peer relevance-measurement session, not as this session — write the stub content to .workflows/.cache/search-relevance/discussion/relevance-measurement/concern-expansion-cache-invalidation.md, then run: node .claude/skills/workflow-engine/scripts/engine.cjs topic triage search-relevance discussion synonym-handling --concern .workflows/.cache/search-relevance/discussion/relevance-measurement/concern-expansion-cache-invalidation.md --slug expansion-cache-invalidation -m "discussion(search-relevance/relevance-measurement): reroute concern to synonym-handling"
